name: Single-View Depth Shape Completion
aliases: Single-View Depth Shape Completion — DeepSDF Optimization with Adaptive Sampling
definition: Recovers complete 3D shape from a single depth image by optimizing a latent code through a differentiable renderer, requiring no additional training.
summary: Single-View Depth Shape Completion recovers 3D shapes from one depth image by optimizing a latent code with adaptive sampling, avoiding fixed-distance methods to better capture thin structures.
